title: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End
author: Kanehito Yamada
read: The story begins where most fantasy adventures usually end. The Heros party has already defeated the Demon King, saving the world. Now, the adventure is over, and the party members go their separate ways.

title: The Ancient Magus Bride
author: Kore Yamazaki
read: Chise Hatori, a neglected teenage orphan who can see terrifying supernatural creatures, decides to sell herself at an underground auction out of sheer despair. She is bought for an immense sum by Elias Ainsworth, a towering, non-human sorcerer with a beastly animal skull for a head.

title: Yona of the Dawn
author: Mizuho Kusanagi
read: Princess Yona lives a sheltered, luxurious life in her kingdom until her beloved cousin commits a bloody betrayal, murdering her father to steal the throne on her sixteenth birthday. Forced to flee the palace overnight, she must learn to survive in a harsh, war-torn world.

title: Anata
author: Yumi Tamura
read: In a futuristic, post-apocalyptic Japan ruled by tyrannical royal tyrants, a prophecy foretells that a child born in a small village will become the "Chosen One" to overthrow the monarchy. When the village hero is brutally murdered, his twin sister cuts her hair and assumes his identity to lead the rebellion.

title: Nier
author: Natsumi Mukai
read: In a medieval fantasy world, there exist outcasts called "+Anima"—humans who possess the magical ability to transform parts of their bodies into animal traits (like bird wings, bear claws, or fish gills). They are feared, treated as monsters, or sold into slavery by normal humans.
